definitions.explanation: Describes the tingling or numbing sensation when circulation is cut off or returning, or from cold or injury.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正座|せいざ}→正座：10552_seiza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していたら→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧じんじん⟦してきた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My legs started tingling from sitting in seiza.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}くて→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧じんじん⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My hands are numb from the cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦ぶつけた→ぶつける：02413_butsukeru⟧⟦{肘|ひじ}→肘：00938_hiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧じんじん⟦{痛|いた}む→痛む：03008_itamu⟧。
examples.english: My elbow tingles with pain from bumping it.

notes:
じんじん is an onomatopoeic word for tingling or numbing sensations.

COMMON CAUSES:
- ⟦{正座|せいざ}→正座：10552_seiza⟧ (sitting in seiza, legs fall asleep)
- ⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧ (cold)
- ⟦{血行|けっこう}→血行：23356_kekkou⟧⟦{不良|ふりょう}→不良：11320_furyou⟧ (poor circulation)
- ⟦ぶつける→ぶつける：02413_butsukeru⟧ (bumping, hitting)

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Very commonly experienced in Japan due to seiza sitting
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦しびれる→痺れる：06814_shibireru⟧ is the standard way to say "my leg fell asleep"

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦しびれる→痺れる：06814_shibireru⟧: to go numb (verb)
- ⟦ちくちく→ちくちく：05372_chikuchiku⟧: prickling
- ⟦ひりひり→ひりひり：05263_hirihiri⟧: stinging
